Now I understand the flow. Let me think about the vulnerability more carefully.

The `STRING_SWITCH(buffer)` in `identify_http_method` reads 4 bytes from `buffer`. If `buffer` is near the end of the data, this could read past the buffer.

But wait, the `read_request_finalizer` requires `\r\n\r\n` to be present in the buffer. So the buffer must contain at least 4 bytes (`\r\n\r\n`). And `buffer` starts at `data_copy[0]`.
